askedAt.description: When the task was asked for, i.e. when the event that caused it happened, in UTC: positionId names the position as it was called then.

type.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
type.description: Id of the task's type, which builds, each time the task runs, what its run is given from the parameters.

params.description: The task's parameters, as its type expects them.

positionId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
positionId.description: Id of the position the task is for, as it was called when the task was asked for: whoever works the position does it.

parentTaskId.description: Id of the task it is a part of, in a tree of tasks. Absent for a task of its own.
parentTaskId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens

causeEventId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
causeEventId.description: Id of the event the task was created for, i.e. the name of its file in .aico/journal. The task's depth is that event's, plus one.

title: AICo task
description: A task for a position, in .aico/tasks/<task-id>.json, the id being its cause event's followed by a hash of its type, position and parameters, so that two machines asking for the same task write the same file. Never modified: the task's state comes from the journal's events.
